entities.summary: Princess Alexandra Elli Francisca Maria of Greece, known professionally as Alexandra Mirzayantz, is a Greek artist, art collector, arts patron, and child life specialist. As the daughter of Prince Michael of Greece and Denmark, she is a member of the Greek royal family and a relative of the Danish royal family. A morganatic descendant of the House of Glücksburg, she is not a Danish princess nor is she entitled to the style Royal Highness as other members of the Greek royal family are. She was born a princess of Greece entitled to the style Your Highness, and was excluded from the line of succession to the Greek throne.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a child life specialist and arts patron, Princess Alexandra Elli Francisca Maria of Greece has made significant contributions to children's healthcare and art conservation in Southern Europe. Her work has had a notable impact on the region.
